categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of pulp, paper, paperboard, wood materials, chemical products, and adhesives. Its product portfolio includes cultural paper, specialty paper, household paper products, and packaging materials. It also engages in the production of green energy and sustainable products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes integrated pulp and paper production processes including wood chip processing, pulping, bleaching, papermaking, coating, and finishing. It emphasizes sustainable manufacturing with certifications like ISO 14001, FSC, and ISO 14067 for carbon footprint. Advanced biomass energy generation and recycling technologies are employed to enhance energy efficiency and reduce emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include cultural publishing industries, packaging manufacturers, industrial users, and end consumers of household paper products. The company serves domestic and international markets, with exports to China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Australia, India, the Americas, and others. It targets environmentally conscious clients with green and recyclable paper products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan with multiple manufacturing plants and offices. The company also has subsidiaries and production facilities in Guangdong Province, China, and sales offices in Hong Kong and Shanghai. Its raw materials are sourced globally from countries including Chile, Brazil, Canada, USA, Finland, Sweden, New Zealand, Japan, Thailand, Australia, and Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the pulp and paper supply chain, producing pulp and paper products from raw wood materials. It integrates upstream activities such as wood chip procurement and downstream activities including paper product manufacturing and sales. It also collaborates closely with downstream packaging and printing industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high value-added specialty papers and environmentally friendly products to meet evolving market demands. The company invests in R&D to improve production efficiency, reduce raw material usage, and develop plastic alternatives from pulp. It focuses on green energy, carbon footprint reduction, circular economy initiatives, and digital transformation to enhance sustainability and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of pulp, paper, paperboard, and related chemical products. The company also earns income from exports and domestic sales across various product lines. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but emphasizes product sales and expanding trade-based sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from domestic and international pulp and paper manufacturers, especially amid global overcapacity and price volatility. It positions itself as a leader in sustainable and green paper products, leveraging certifications and innovation to differentiate. It maintains market share through flexible production and expanding specialty paper markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$20.77 billion, slightly down from the previous year, with a net loss of about NT$250 million. It produced over 342,000 tons of pulp, 358,000 tons of paper, and 122,000 tons of paperboard. The company has shown resilience with ongoing investments in green energy and digital upgrades, aiming for stable long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes sustainable, environmentally friendly products with certifications such as FSC and carbon footprint labels. It offers innovative pulp-based plastic alternatives and full lifecycle assessed products. Its commitment to green manufacturing, energy self-sufficiency, and circular economy principles provides customers with differentiated value aligned with global sustainability trends.
